emotional_tone: Trust, Quality, Freshness, Tradition, Premium Artisan

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary-dark
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-primary-dark

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing, optical alignment, bento grids for galleries, large product focus.
layout_and_spacing.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/20 dark:bg-black/60 dark:border-white/10

components.hero: Split layout or overlapping container. Image on right or background with subtle dark/warm overlay (bg-black/30). Text left aligned, massive Serif heading.
components.buttons: Primary CTA uses Rich Red (bg-[#8B1E0F]) with white text. Hover states use slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase. Floating WhatsApp uses WhatsApp Green (#25D366) with glassmorphism tooltip.
components.product_cards: Rounded corners (rounded-2xl), overflow-hidden, image container with aspect-square or 4:5. Hover effect: image scales up 105%. Card has pure white bg (light mode) with very subtle warm shadow.
components.navigation: Sticky, fixed top. Uses Crystal Glassmorphism. Logo in Serif font or image. Links are clean Outfit text.
components.testimonials: Google Reviews style but elevated. Cards with star ratings (Gold #D4AF37), avatar, and elegant quote styling.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion: initial opacity-0, y-10. whileInView opacity-100, y-0. transition duration-0.7 ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Images scale slightly. Cards lift slightly. Buttons brighten on hover.

technical_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming.
technical_rules.ui_library: shadcn/ui customized with the color palette. Do not use default Vercel-like borders or gray text.
technical_rules.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx extensions. Do not use .tsx or .ts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast, especially over images (use text shadows or gradient overlays).
Build the navigation as a sticky glassmorphic header.
Implement Floating Action Buttons (WhatsApp and Call) fixed to bottom right using z-50.
Use Framer Motion for scroll animations on sections to give a premium feel.
Create a responsive bento grid for the Gallery section.
For the Products page, implement client-side category filtering and search for the catalogue.
Integrate the 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' fonts via Google Fonts.
Implement Dark Mode using Tailwind's 'dark:' variant classes, switching out the cream backgrounds for deep espresso/charcoal tones.
Create Shadcn components in JS, keeping in mind the 'file_extensions' rule.
